create table INSUR_EXPORT.门诊费用明细清单
as(  select nvl( cc.clinic_no, (select to_char(visit_date,'yyyymmdd')||visit_no from outp_orders_costs where rcpt_no=bb.rcpt_no and rownum=1))  as 唯一就诊标识,
         bb.patient_id as 门诊号,
         bb.name as 姓名,
         (select pmi.sex from pat_master_index pmi where bb.PATIENT_ID=pmi.patient_id) as 性别,
         (select pmi.id_no from pat_master_index pmi where bb.PATIENT_ID=pmi.patient_id) as 身份证号码,
         FLOOR(MONTHS_BETWEEN(trunc(aa.VISIT_DATE),
         (select pmi.DATE_OF_BIRTH from pat_master_index pmi where bb.PATIENT_ID=pmi.patient_id))/12) as 就医年龄,
         aa.VISIT_DATE as 就诊日期,
         (select d.dept_name from dept_dict d where d.dept_code = cc.ordered_by_dept) as 入院科室,
         aa.appoint_no as 单据号,
         ' ' as 物价编码,
         aa.ITEM_CODE as 医院项目编码,
         aa.ITEM_NAME as 医院项目名称,
         aa.ITEM_SPEC as 规格,
         aa.item_price as 单价,
         aa.UNITS as 计量单位,
         aa.AMOUNT as 数量,
         aa.COSTS as 金额,
         bb.visit_date as 费用发生时间,
         (select d.dept_name from dept_dict d where d.dept_code = cc.ordered_by_dept)开单科室,
         (SELECT dept_name FROM dept_dict WHERE dept_code = aa.performed_by) as 计费科室,
         (case when aa.item_class in('A','B') then '药品' when aa.item_class in('I' ) then '服务设施' else '诊疗项目'
         end ) as 费用大类,
         (SELECT r.class_name FROM BILL_ITEM_CLASS_DICT r WHERE r.class_code = aa.item_class) as 收费类别
  FROM outp_bill_items aa 
  join outp_rcpt_master bb on bb.rcpt_no = aa.rcpt_no
  join outp_order_desc cc on bb.rcpt_no = cc.rcpt_no AND aa.visit_no = cc.visit_no AND aa.VISIT_DATE = cc.VISIT_DATE
  where trunc(bb.visit_date)>=to_date('?,'yyyy-mm-dd')
  and trunc(bb.visit_date)<to_date('?,'yyyy-mm-dd')
)

               and STOP_DATE IS NULL) * b.AMOUNT) 金额
  from CLINIC_ITEM_DICT a, CLINIC_VS_CHARGE b, CLINIC_ITEM_NAME_DICT c
 where a.ITEM_CLASS = b.clinic_item_class

 b.NAME 患者姓名

  AND ACTION IN ('新入', '换床')
  AND BED_NO > 499
  AND BED_NO < 600) TT) T

AND T.VISIT_ID = INP_BILL_DETAIL.VISIT_ID
AND BILLING_DATE_TIME BETWEEN LOG_DATE_TIME AND TIME

SELECT PERFORMED_BY,
       ITEM_CODE,
       ITEM_NAME,
       sum(AMOUNT)  AS 数量,
       sum(CHARGES) AS 费用
FROM ((SELECT (SELECT DEPT_NAME FROM DEPT_DICT WHERE DEPT_CODE = D.PERFORMED_BY) AS PERFORMED_BY,
              D.ITEM_CODE                                                        AS ITEM_CODE,
              D.ITEM_NAME                                                        AS ITEM_NAME,
              sum(D.AMOUNT)                                                      AS AMOUNT,
              sum(D.CHARGES)                                                     AS CHARGES
       FROM INP_BILL_DETAIL D
       WHERE D.PERFORMED_BY = '?
         AND D.BILLING_DATE_TIME >= to_date('?, 'yyyyMMdd')
         AND D.BILLING_DATE_TIME < to_date('?, 'yyyyMMdd')
         AND D.ITEM_CODE IN (SELECT ITEM_CODE FROM T_JIXIAO_PROJECT WHERE TYPE = 'XHNJ')
       GROUP BY D.PERFORMED_BY, D.ITEM_NAME, D.ITEM_CODE)
      UNION
      (SELECT (SELECT DEPT_NAME FROM DEPT_DICT WHERE DEPT_CODE = D.PERFORMED_BY) AS PERFORMED_BY,
              D.ITEM_CODE                                                        AS ITEM_CODE,
              D.ITEM_NAME                                                        AS ITEM_NAME,
              sum(D.AMOUNT)                                                      AS AMOUNT,
              sum(D.CHARGES)                                                     AS CHARGES
       FROM OUTP_BILL_ITEMS D
       WHERE D.PERFORMED_BY = '?
         AND D.VISIT_DATE >= to_date('?, 'yyyyMMdd')
         AND D.VISIT_DATE < to_date('?, 'yyyyMMdd')
         AND D.ITEM_CODE IN (SELECT ITEM_CODE FROM T_JIXIAO_PROJECT WHERE TYPE = 'XHNJ')
       GROUP BY D.PERFORMED_BY, D.ITEM_NAME, D.ITEM_CODE))
GROUP BY PERFORMED_BY, ITEM_CODE, ITEM_NAME

                      CASE
                          WHEN nvl(ZFBL, 100) = 0 THEN '甲类'
                          WHEN nvl(ZFBL, 100) = 100 THEN '乙类'
                          ELSE '全自费' END ZFBL,
                      sum(CHARGES)       CHARGES

SELECT N.EINV_DICT_CODE, N.EINV_DICT_NAME, sum(T.COSTS) AS FEE
FROM (
         SELECT M.CLASS_ON_INP_RCPT, M.COSTS AS COSTS
         FROM (
                  SELECT sum(COSTS) AS COSTS,
                         CLASS_ON_INP_RCPT
                  FROM (
                           SELECT CLASS_ON_INP_RCPT, ITEM_CODE,
                                  replace(replace(replace(replace(A.ITEM_NAME, '\', '\\'), '"', '\"'), '{', '\{'), '}','\}')                                 ITEM_NAME,
                                  replace(replace(replace(replace(A.ITEM_SPEC, '\', '\\'), '"', '\"'), '{', '\{'), '}','\}')                                 ITEM_SPEC,
                                  UNITS, ITEM_PRICE, trunc(COSTS, 2) AS COSTS
                           FROM INP_BILL_DETAIL A
                           WHERE A.PATIENT_ID = :pid
                             AND VISIT_ID = :vid
                             AND A.RCPT_NO = :rcpno
                           UNION ALL
                           SELECT CLASS_ON_INP_RCPT, ITEM_CODE,
                                  replace(replace(replace(replace(A.ITEM_NAME, '\', '\\'), '"', '\"'), '{', '\{'), '}','\}')                                 ITEM_NAME,
                                  replace(replace(replace(replace(A.ITEM_SPEC, '\', '\\'), '"', '\"'), '{', '\{'), '}','\}')                                 ITEM_SPEC,
                                  UNITS, ITEM_PRICE, trunc(COSTS, 2) AS COSTS
                           FROM INP_BILL_DETAIL_JZ A
                           WHERE A.PATIENT_ID = :pid
                             AND VISIT_ID = :vid
                             AND A.RCPT_NO = :rcpno
                       )
                  GROUP BY CLASS_ON_INP_RCPT, ITEM_CODE, ITEM_NAME, ITEM_SPEC, UNITS, ITEM_PRICE
              ) M
     ) T,
     (SELECT HIS_DICT_CODE, HIS_DICT_NAME, EINV_DICT_CODE, EINV_DICT_NAME
      FROM OUTPBILL.EINV_COMM_DATA A
      WHERE A.TYPE_CODE = 'INPFEE_VS') N
WHERE T.CLASS_ON_INP_RCPT = N.HIS_DICT_CODE
GROUP BY N.EINV_DICT_CODE, N.EINV_DICT_NAME

         SELECT M.CLASS_ON_INP_RCPT, M.COSTS AS COSTS

                  SELECT sum(COSTS) AS COSTS, CLASS_ON_INP_RCPT
                  FROM (
                           SELECT CLASS_ON_INP_RCPT,

                           FROM INP_BILL_DETAIL A
                           WHERE A.PATIENT_ID = '?
                             AND VISIT_ID = 1

                                  trunc(COSTS, 2) AS COSTS
                           FROM INP_BILL_DETAIL_JZ A
                           WHERE A.PATIENT_ID = '?
                             AND VISIT_ID = 1
                             AND A.RCPT_NO = '?
                       )
                  GROUP BY CLASS_ON_INP_RCPT
              ) M
     ) T,
     (SELECT HIS_DICT_CODE, HIS_DICT_NAME, EINV_DICT_CODE, EINV_DICT_NAME
      FROM OUTPBILL.EINV_COMM_DATA A
      WHERE A.TYPE_CODE = 'INPFEE_VS') N

       replace(replace(A.ITEM_NAME, '\', '\\'), '"', '\"') AS YYXMMC_JN,
       nvl(B.ITEM_CODE, A.ITEM_CODE)                       AS YYXMBM_JN,
       replace(replace(A.ITEM_SPEC, '\', '\\'), '"', '\"')    ITEM_SPEC,
       A.ITEM_CLASS,
       A.AMOUNT,
       A.UNITS,
       A.ORDERED_BY,
       A.PERFORMED_BY,
       A.COSTS,
       A.CHARGES,
       nvl(A.ZFBL, B.BILI * 100)                              ZFBL,
       A.BILLING_DATE_TIME,
       A.OPERATOR_NO,
       A.ITEM_PRICE,
       A.FYBCLB,
       A.TRANS_FLAG,
       A.PATIENT_ID,
       A.VISIT_ID,
       A.ITEM_NO,
       B.BILI,
       A.INSUR_FLAG,
       A.YB_SEND_DATE,
       A.DOCTOR_USER,
       ''                                                     GSBZ,
       (CASE
            WHEN (SELECT count(*)
                  FROM (SELECT ITEM_CODE, BILI, SBJGBM
                        FROM INSURANCE.YYXMBM
                        GROUP BY ITEM_CODE, BILI, SBJGBM)
                  WHERE SBJGBM IN
                        (SELECT INSUR_TYPE
                         FROM CHARGE_TYPE_DICT
                         WHERE CHARGE_TYPE_NAME ='?)
                    AND ITEM_CODE = upper(B.ITEM_CODE)) > 1 THEN
                '多比例'
            ELSE
                '单比例'
           END)                                            AS YBTM,
       A.CATALOGUE_STATUS
FROM INP_BILL_DETAIL A LEFT JOIN (SELECT ITEM_CODE, min(BILI) BILI, SBJGBM
                                  FROM INSURANCE.YYXMBM
                                  WHERE SBJGBM IN (SELECT INSUR_TYPE
                                        FROM CHARGE_TYPE_DICT
                                        WHERE CHARGE_TYPE_NAME ='?)
                                  GROUP BY ITEM_CODE, SBJGBM) B
                                 ON A.ITEM_CODE = upper(B.ITEM_CODE)
                                     AND B.SBJGBM IN (SELECT INSUR_TYPE
                                                      FROM CHARGE_TYPE_DICT
                                                      WHERE CHARGE_TYPE_NAME ='?)
WHERE (A.INSUR_FLAG IS NULL OR A.INSUR_FLAG = 0)

SELECT DETAIL.ITEM_CLASS,
       DETAIL.ITEM_NAME,
       DETAIL.ITEM_CODE,
       DETAIL.ITEM_SPEC,
       DETAIL.UNITS,
       DETAIL.ITEM_PRICE,
       sum(DETAIL.AMOUNT)  AMOUNT,
       sum(DETAIL.COSTS)   COSTS,
       sum(DETAIL.CHARGES) CHARGES,
       DRUG.CLASS_NAME,
       DETAIL.CLASS_ON_INP_RCPT,
       CASE DETAIL.ITEM_CLASS
           WHEN 'A' THEN (SELECT YB_CODE FROM DRUG_DICT WHERE DRUG_CODE = ITEM_CODE AND DRUG_SPEC = ITEM_SPEC)
           WHEN 'B' THEN (SELECT YB_CODE FROM DRUG_DICT WHERE DRUG_CODE = ITEM_CODE AND DRUG_SPEC = ITEM_SPEC)
           WHEN 'C' THEN (SELECT COUNTRY_CODE FROM PRICE_ITEM_NAME_DICT WHERE DETAIL.ITEM_CODE = PRICE_ITEM_NAME_DICT.ITEM_CODE AND DETAIL.ITEM_CLASS = PRICE_ITEM_NAME_DICT.ITEM_CLASS AND DETAIL.ITEM_NAME = PRICE_ITEM_NAME_DICT.ITEM_NAME)
           WHEN 'D' THEN (SELECT COUNTRY_CODE FROM PRICE_ITEM_NAME_DICT WHERE DETAIL.ITEM_CODE = PRICE_ITEM_NAME_DICT.ITEM_CODE AND DETAIL.ITEM_CLASS = PRICE_ITEM_NAME_DICT.ITEM_CLASS AND DETAIL.ITEM_NAME = PRICE_ITEM_NAME_DICT.ITEM_NAME)
           WHEN 'E' THEN (SELECT COUNTRY_CODE FROM PRICE_ITEM_NAME_DICT WHERE DETAIL.ITEM_CODE = PRICE_ITEM_NAME_DICT.ITEM_CODE AND DETAIL.ITEM_CLASS = PRICE_ITEM_NAME_DICT.ITEM_CLASS AND DETAIL.ITEM_NAME = PRICE_ITEM_NAME_DICT.ITEM_NAME)
           when 'F' THEN (SELECT COUNTRY_CODE FROM PRICE_ITEM_NAME_DICT WHERE DETAIL.ITEM_CODE = PRICE_ITEM_NAME_DICT.ITEM_CODE AND DETAIL.ITEM_CLASS = PRICE_ITEM_NAME_DICT.ITEM_CLASS AND DETAIL.ITEM_NAME = PRICE_ITEM_NAME_DICT.ITEM_NAME)
           when 'G' THEN (SELECT COUNTRY_CODE FROM PRICE_ITEM_NAME_DICT WHERE DETAIL.ITEM_CODE = PRICE_ITEM_NAME_DICT.ITEM_CODE AND DETAIL.ITEM_CLASS = PRICE_ITEM_NAME_DICT.ITEM_CLASS AND DETAIL.ITEM_NAME = PRICE_ITEM_NAME_DICT.ITEM_NAME)
           when 'H' THEN (SELECT COUNTRY_CODE FROM PRICE_ITEM_NAME_DICT WHERE DETAIL.ITEM_CODE = PRICE_ITEM_NAME_DICT.ITEM_CODE AND DETAIL.ITEM_CLASS = PRICE_ITEM_NAME_DICT.ITEM_CLASS AND DETAIL.ITEM_NAME = PRICE_ITEM_NAME_DICT.ITEM_NAME)
        ELSE '' END COUNTRY_CODE,
        (SELECT PROVINCE_CODE FROM PRICE_ITEM_NAME_DICT WHERE DETAIL.ITEM_CODE = PRICE_ITEM_NAME_DICT.ITEM_CODE AND DETAIL.ITEM_CLASS = PRICE_ITEM_NAME_DICT.ITEM_CLASS AND DETAIL.ITEM_NAME = PRICE_ITEM_NAME_DICT.ITEM_NAME) PROVINCE_CODE
FROM (SELECT P.CHARGE_TYPE, INP_BILL_DETAIL.ITEM_CLASS,
             INP_BILL_DETAIL.ITEM_NAME, INP_BILL_DETAIL.ITEM_CODE,
             INP_BILL_DETAIL.ITEM_SPEC, INP_BILL_DETAIL.UNITS,
             INP_BILL_DETAIL.CLASS_ON_INP_RCPT, nvl(INP_BILL_DETAIL.ITEM_PRICE, 0) ITEM_PRICE,
             sum(INP_BILL_DETAIL.AMOUNT)                                           AMOUNT,
             sum(INP_BILL_DETAIL.COSTS)                                            COSTS,
             sum(INP_BILL_DETAIL.CHARGES)                                          CHARGES
      FROM INP_BILL_DETAIL,
           PAT_VISIT P
      WHERE INP_BILL_DETAIL.PATIENT_ID = P.PATIENT_ID
        AND INP_BILL_DETAIL.VISIT_ID = P.VISIT_ID
      GROUP BY P.CHARGE_TYPE, INP_BILL_DETAIL.ITEM_CLASS,
               INP_BILL_DETAIL.ITEM_NAME, INP_BILL_DETAIL.ITEM_CODE,
               INP_BILL_DETAIL.ITEM_SPEC, INP_BILL_DETAIL.UNITS,
               INP_BILL_DETAIL.CLASS_ON_INP_RCPT, INP_BILL_DETAIL.ITEM_PRICE) DETAIL,
     (SELECT O.CHARGE_TYPE CHARGE_TYPE, C.CLASS_NAME CLASS_NAME,
             O.DRUG_SPEC   DRUG_SPEC, O.DRUG_CODE DRUG_CODE, O.ITEM_CLASS ITEM_CLASS
      FROM OFFICIAL_DRUG_CATALOG O,
           OFFICIAL_DRUG_CATALOG_CLASS C
      WHERE O.CONSTRAINED_LEVEL = C.CLASS_CODE) DRUG
WHERE DETAIL.CHARGE_TYPE = DRUG.CHARGE_TYPE(+)
  AND DETAIL.ITEM_CLASS = DRUG.ITEM_CLASS(+)
  AND DETAIL.ITEM_CODE = DRUG.DRUG_CODE(+)
  AND DETAIL.ITEM_SPEC = DRUG.DRUG_SPEC(+)
GROUP BY DETAIL.ITEM_CLASS,
         ITEM_NAME,
